E0161

`{what}`

What

`{what}`

Why

Increment and decrement edit the binding or field in place; see the sigil reading rule above (D-INCR1).

Fix

Declare with `:=` or mark the parameter with the write-access marker `&` if the function should change it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0161: tests/ui/incr_immut.stderr.

Error [E0161]: `x` was made with `::`, so it can't change
  --> tests/ui/incr_immut.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     x++
    |     ^
 Why: only `:=` bindings and parameters with the write-access marker `&` can use `++`/`--`
 Fix: declare it with `x := ...` instead
